blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A comparative explainability framework is presented to audit DeBERTa-v3 under zero-shot classification of medical abstracts. The work addresses the disagreement problem in Explainable Artificial Intelligence, where different attribution methods produce divergent explanations for the same input and prediction. A natural language inference engine is implemented over the Medical Abstracts corpus with five enriched hypotheses per diagnostic category and a balanced sample of one thousand texts per class. Five explanation methods are compared: SHAP and LIME as model-agnostic approaches, occlusion and Input x Gradient as deep-learning-specific approaches, and Attention x Gradient as a transformer-specific approach. Explanations are standardized through top-token attribution, and pairwise agreement is quantified using the Jaccard index. High predictive accuracy is achieved across well-defined clinical domains, whereas performance degrades under high semantic ambiguity. Explanatory stability directly mirrors predictive certainty, exhibiting strong convergence in univalent categories and a marked drop under diagnostic uncertainty. Furthermore, qualitative error auditing uncovers three systemic failure mechanisms: lexical hypersensitivity, semantic overlap, and loss of attribution coherence. The results support the combined use of several explanation methods and quantitative agreement metrics when auditing transformer-based models in medical text classification, and suggest prioritizing specific clinical ontologies over broad diagnostic labels.
blocks.zh: 在医学摘要的零镜头分类下,向审计DeBERTa-v3提供了可比较解释性框架。 这项工作解决了解释人工智能中的分歧问题,在这种智能中,不同的归属方法对相同的输入和预测产生不同的解释. 在《医学摘要》中采用了自然语言推论引擎,每个诊断类别有五个丰富的假设,每个类别有一千个文本的均衡样本。 比较了5种解释方法:SHAP和LIME作为模型不可知的方法, 隐含和输入 x 渐变作为深层学习的特有方法, 注意 x 渐变作为变压器特有方法. 解释通过顶端归属实现标准化,对偶协议使用Jaccard指数量化. 在明确界定的临床领域实现高预测准确性,而性能则在高度语义模糊的情况下退化。 解释性稳定性直接反映了预测性确定性,在单值类别中表现出强烈的趋同性,诊断性不确定性下明显下降。 此外,定性错误审计揭示了三种系统故障机制:语法超敏、语义重叠和归属一致性丧失。 这些结果支持在医学文本分类中审计基于变压器的模型时综合使用几种解释方法和定量协议度量衡,并建议将具体的临床本体学置于宽泛的诊断标签之上。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Transformer models have become the dominant architecture in natural language processing ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) . Their capacity to model long-range dependencies through attention mechanisms has improved many text classification tasks, including clinical text classification where transformer backbones now set the state of the art ( Mishra and Soni, 2025 ; Saedi et al., 2023 ) . However, this performance comes with an increase in architectural complexity, which turns the internal decision process into a black box that is difficult to inspect. The problem becomes more salient in clinical settings, where an automated decision may influence diagnosis and patient safety: a model that is globally accurate but locally opaque offers little reassurance to a clinician who must justify an individual prediction, and a spurious lexical cue may be confounded with a legitimate clinical descriptor ( European Data Protection Supervisor, 2023 ) . The European AI Act reinforces the need for auditability in high-risk systems such as automated diagnosis ( Di Marino and others, 2025 ; Barredo Arrieta et al., 2020 ) , and the broader regulatory debate around the General Data Protection Regulation has further pushed the field towards post-hoc explanations that are both plausible to a human reader and technically faithful to the reasoning of the model ( European Parliament and Council of the European Union, 2016 ; Lipton, 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 变形器模型已经成为自然语言处理中的主导架构(Vaswani等人,2017年). 他们通过关注机制模拟远程依赖的能力改善了许多文本分类任务,包括临床文本分类,其中变压器骨干现在设定了最新状态(Mishra and Soni,2025;Saedi等人,2023年). 然而,这种表现伴随着建筑复杂性的增加,使得内部决策过程变成了一个难以检查的黑匣子. 在临床环境中,问题变得更加突出,自动决定可能会影响诊断和病人的安全:全球准确但局部不透明的模型不会为必须证明个人预测有理的临床医生提供多少保证,假名词提示可能与合法的临床描述符相混淆(欧洲数据保护主管,2023年)。 欧洲AI法案强化了在诸如自动化诊断(Di Marino等人,2025年;Barredo Arrieta等人,2020年)等高风险系统中的可审计性的必要性,围绕"一般数据保护条例"的更广泛的监管辩论进一步将该领域推向了事后解释,既让人类读者相信,又在技术上忠实于模型推理(欧洲议会和欧洲联盟理事会,2016年;利普顿,2018年).

blocks.en: Explainable Artificial Intelligence, or XAI, provides methods to attribute model predictions to input features Dwivedi et al. (2023) . These methods range from model-agnostic approaches such as SHAP ( Lundberg and Lee, 2017 ) and LIME ( Ribeiro et al., 2016a ) to model-specific approaches based on gradients or attention. A recurrent limitation reported in the literature is the disagreement problem: different explanation methods often produce inconsistent or contradictory attributions for the same prediction ( Longo et al., 2024a ; Krishna et al., 2022 ) . The absence of a ground-truth explanation complicates empirical validation and makes the choice of a single explainer unreliable in high-stakes domains, where a practitioner cannot easily adjudicate between two contradictory post-hoc justifications. This concern has motivated the development of standardized evaluation frameworks such as Quantus ( Hedström and others, 2023 ) and BEExAI ( Sithakoul et al., 2024 ) , but their adoption remains uneven, and most applied studies still rely on a single attribution method reported through visual inspection.
blocks.zh: 解释性人工智能,或称XAI,提供了将模型预测归属于输入特征Dwivedi等人(2023年)的方法. 这些方法从SHAP(Lundberg and Lee,2017)和LIME(Ribeiro等人,2016年a)等模型不可知论方法到基于梯度或关注的模型特定方法. 文献中报告的一个反复出现的局限性是分歧问题:不同的解释方法往往对同一预测产生不一致或矛盾的归属(Longo等人,2024a;Krishna等人,2022 ). 缺乏地面真实性解释使经验验证复杂化,并使在高考领域选择单一解释器不可靠,在高考领域,从业者无法轻易在两个相互矛盾的后考证理由之间作出判断. 这一关切促使制定了标准化评价框架,如Quantus(Hedström等人,2023年)和BEExAI(Sithakoul等人,2024年),但这些框架的采用仍然不均衡,大多数应用研究仍然依赖通过目视检查报告的单一归属方法.

blocks.en: This paper studies that problem in a concrete medical text classification setting. DeBERTa-v3 ( He et al., 2021 ) is audited under a zero-shot paradigm based on natural language inference. The model classifies medical abstracts into five diagnostic categories without task-specific training, which is a deployment scenario of practical interest in specialized clinical domains where labelled corpora are scarce. Because standard XAI libraries show limited compatibility with DeBERTa-v3, gradient and perturbation methods are implemented natively for this architecture. The framework then compares five explanation methods over the twenty most relevant tokens and quantifies pairwise agreement with the Jaccard index, so that the disagreement problem is measured directly rather than only illustrated visually. A second protocol uses SHAP to inspect misclassified cases of the general pathological category, where the model shows the lowest predictive performance, and identifies recurring failure patterns that link the predictive collapse to the structure of the explanations.
blocks.zh: 本文在具体的医学文本分类中研究了这个问题. DeBERTa-v3(He等人,2021年)根据自然语言推论,在零镜头范式下进行审计. 该模型将医疗摘要归类为五个诊断类别,而不进行特定任务培训,这是在贴有标签的公司稀缺的专业临床领域实际感兴趣的部署情景。 因为标准 XAI 库显示与 DeBERTa-v3 的兼容性有限,所以对于这个架构,梯度和扰动方法都是在本土执行的. 该框架然后将20个最相关的符号的5个解释方法进行比较,并用Jaccard指数对成对协议进行量化,以便直接衡量分歧问题,而不是仅仅以视觉方式说明。 第二种协议使用SHAP来检查一般病理类的错分类病例,其中模型显示的预测性能最低,并确定了将预测性崩溃与解释结构联系起来的反复发生故障模式.

blocks.en: The contributions are: (i) a zero-shot inference engine with multivariate prompt engineering for medical abstract classification over DeBERTa-v3, formulated as a natural language inference problem with five enriched hypotheses per category; (ii) a comparative explainability framework that combines agnostic, deep-learning-specific, and transformer-specific methods adapted to DeBERTa-v3, filling a gap in the XAI literature where this architecture has been less studied than BERT or RoBERTa; (iii) a quantitative validation protocol based on Top-20 token attribution and the Jaccard index that measures the disagreement problem directly across method families and clinical categories; and (iv) an error analysis of the general category that documents lexical hypersensitivity, semantic overlap, and loss of attribution coherence as recurring failure patterns linking the predictive collapse to the structure of the explanations. Contribution (i) operationalizes the zero-shot Natural Language Inference (NLI) formulation proposed by Laurer et al. (2023) on a medical corpus; the novelty of the paper resides in contributions (ii)–(iv), which together expose the dependence of explanation agreement on clinical specificity and on the family of the explainer.
blocks.zh: 其贡献是:(一) 一个零射线推论引擎,在DeBERTa-v3上进行医学抽象分类的多变即时工程,作为自然语言推论问题制定,每个类别有五个丰富的假设;(二) 一个比较可解释性框架,结合了DeBERTa-v3所适应的不可知性、深度学习和变压器专用方法,填补了XAI文献中这一结构的研究少于BERT或RoBERTa的空白;(三) 基于Top-20标志归属和Jacard指数的定量验证协议,直接衡量不同方法家族和临床类别之间的分歧问题;(四) 对将预测崩溃与解释结构联系起来的经常性失败模式,导致归属一致性的丧失。 贡献(一) 将Laurer等人(2023年)提出的 " 自然语言推论 " (NLI)配方付诸实施;论文的新颖之处在于贡献(二)-(四),这些贡献共同暴露了解释协议对临床特殊性和解释者家庭的依赖性。

blocks.en: The remainder of the paper is organized as follows. Section 2 reviews XAI methods for text and transformers, together with the toolkits and benchmarks that systematize their evaluation. Section 3 details the methodology followed, including the corpus, the inference engine, the explanation methods, the standardization protocol, the disagreement quantification, and the error analysis protocol. Section 4 describes the preprocessing, reproducibility, and evaluation procedures, as well as the implementation details. Section 5 reports the predictive performance, the explainability comparison, the cross-class agreement analysis, and the error analysis of the general pathological category. Section 6 discusses the findings in the light of previous reports and of the regulatory context. Section 7 examines the study’s limitations and validity considerations. Section 8 concludes and outlines future work.
blocks.zh: 本文的其余部分编排如下。 第2节审查了XAI文本和变压器的方法,以及使其评价系统化的工具包和基准。 第3节详细介绍了所采用的方法,包括实体、推论引擎、解释方法、标准化协议、分歧量化和错误分析协议。 第4节叙述预处理、可复制性和评价程序以及执行细节。 第5节报告了预测性能,可解释性比较,跨类协议分析,以及一般病理类的错误分析. 第6节根据以前的报告和监管背景讨论了调查结果。 第7节审查了研究的局限性和有效性。 第8节结束并概述了今后的工作。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: This section reviews the background against which the present contribution is positioned. First, the work is placed within the broader taxonomy of XAI methods and the recent shift from visual to quantitative evaluation, including the regulatory pressure motivating the audit of high-stakes models. Second, attribution methods for transformer-based encoders are discussed, given that DeBERTa-v3 is the architecture under study. Finally, recent advances respecting the internal structure of transformers are summarized, the most widely used software libraries and benchmarks are contrasted through a comparative table, and the specific case of XAI applied to medical text classification is presented as the deployment domain of this paper.
blocks.zh: 本节审查本捐款的背景。 首先,这项工作被置于XAI方法的更广泛分类和最近从视觉评价向定量评价的转变之中,包括促使审计高收量模型的监管压力。 第二,讨论变压器编码器的归属方法,因为DeBERTa-v3是正在研究的架构. 最后,总结了最近在变压器内部结构方面取得的进展,通过一个比较表对比了最广泛使用的软件库和基准,将适用于医疗文本分类的XAI具体案例作为本文件的部署领域。

blocks.en: 2.1 XAI taxonomies and evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.1 XAI分类和评价

blocks.en: XAI methods can be classified by the moment of explanation generation, by their scope, and by their dependence on the model ( Molnar, 2018 ; Barredo Arrieta et al., 2020 ) . Ante-hoc methods build interpretability into the model design, while post-hoc methods are applied after training. Model-agnostic methods operate only on inputs and outputs, whereas model-specific methods use internal parameters or gradients. Local explanations address individual predictions, and global explanations describe overall model behavior. The clinical domain requires both levels: a global audit of the system and a local justification for each decision ( Barredo Arrieta et al., 2020 ) , since a classifier that is globally accurate but locally opaque offers little reassurance to a clinician who must justify an individual prediction. The recent distinction between faithfulness (whether the explanation reflects the actual model computation) and plausibility (whether the explanation is convincing to a human) has become central to this discussion ( Jacovi and Goldberg, 2020 ; Lipton, 2018 ) , and the cognitive notion of interpretability itself has been formalized as a multifaceted property rather than a single scalar ( Longo et al., 2024a ) .
blocks.zh: XAI方法可以按解释生成的时刻,范围,以及对模型的依赖程度进行分类(Molnar,2018;Barredo Arrieta等人,2020年). Ante-hoc方法将可解释性构建到模型设计中,而Hoc后方法则在训练后应用. 模型不可知性方法只使用投入和产出,而模型特定方法则使用内部参数或梯度. 地方解释针对个人预测,全球解释描述整体模型行为. 临床领域要求两个层次:对系统进行全球审计,对每项决定提出当地理由(Barredo Arrieta等人,2020年),因为一个全球准确但局部不透明的分类器对必须证明个人预测合理的临床医生没有多少保证。 最近对忠诚(解释是否反映了实际模型计算)和可信度(解释是否使人信服)的区分成为了这次讨论的核心(Jacovi and Goldberg, 2020; Lipton, 2018),而可解释性的认知概念本身被正式确定为一个多方面的财产,而不是一个单一的scalar(Longo等人, 2024a). 。 。 。

blocks.en: The evaluation of explanations has moved from visual inspection to quantitative assessment. Two complementary lines of work have consolidated: sanity-check procedures, which verify that an explanation actually depends on the model rather than on artefacts of the data or the attribution code ( Adebayo et al., 2018 ) ; and robustness analyses, which measure how stable an attribution is under small perturbations of the input or the model parameters ( Alvarez-Melis and Jaakkola, 2018 ) . Frameworks such as Quantus ( Hedström and others, 2023 ) and BEExAI ( Sithakoul et al., 2024 ) provide standardized metrics for fidelity, robustness, and complexity, and recent work attempts a unifying categorical foundation that organizes the proliferation of metrics into a coherent taxonomy ( Giannini et al., 2024 ) . Despite these advances, the disagreement problem remains a central concern: when explanations are inconsistent, their practical use becomes difficult to justify ( Longo et al., 2024a ; Krishna et al., 2022 ) . This situation is especially delicate in medical applications, where spurious correlations can be confused with legitimate clinical features ( European Data Protection Supervisor, 2023 ) , and where a regulatory push toward auditability has emerged in the European AI Act ( Di Marino and others, 2025 ) and the broader debate on explainability requirements under the General Data Protection Regulation ( European Parliament and Council of the European Union, 2016 ) .
blocks.zh: 对解释的评价已从目视检查转向定量评估。 两条互补的工作线合并了:疗理检查程序,该程序核实解释实际上取决于数据或归属代码的模型而非人工制品(Adebayo等人,2018年);以及强性分析,该分析衡量输入或模型参数小扰动下归属的稳定性(Alvarez-Meris和Jaakkola,2018年)。 Quantus(Hedström等人,2023年)和BEExAI(Sithakoul等人,2024年)等框架为忠诚性、稳健性和复杂性提供了标准化的衡量标准,最近的工作试图建立统一、明确的基础,将衡量标准扩散成一个连贯的分类(Giannini等人,2024年)。 尽管取得了这些进展,但分歧问题仍然是一个主要关切问题:当解释不一致时,解释的实际使用变得难以为之辩护(Longo等人,2024a;Krishna等人,2022年)。 在医学应用中,这种情况特别微妙,虚假的关联性可能与合法的临床特征相混淆(欧洲数据保护监督,2023年),在"欧洲AI法案"(Di Marino等,2025年)中出现了监管性推动可审计性的情况,在"一般数据保护条例"(欧洲议会和欧洲联盟理事会,2016年)下对可解释性要求的更广泛辩论.

blocks.en: 2.2 XAI for transformer-based models
blocks.zh: 2.2 XAI用于变压器型号

blocks.en: Early work questioned the interpretability of attention weights. Serrano and Smith (2019) showed that attention is not always a reliable explanation, because attention heads can highlight syntactically necessary tokens without causal influence on the prediction. Jain and Wallace (2019) reported similar evidence and motivated hybrid approaches that combine attention with gradient information. Chefer et al. (2021) proposed a transformer interpretability method based on conservative propagation, which has influenced subsequent attribution techniques for attention-based models. A complementary line of work applies attention flow to quantify how information propagates through the stacked layers of a transformer, providing a less noisy alternative to raw attention inspection ( Abnar and Zuidema, 2020 ) , and occlusion combined with language modelling has been studied as a post-hoc variant for sequence classifiers ( Harbecke, 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 早期的工作对注意力重量的可解释性提出了质疑. 塞拉诺和史密斯(2019年)表明关注并不总是一个可靠的解释,因为关注头可以突出战术上必要的符号,而不会对预测产生因果关系. Jain和Wallace (2019年)报告了类似的证据,并激发了将注意力与梯度信息相结合的混合方法. Chefer等人(2021年)提出了一种基于保守传播的变压器可解释性方法,这种方法影响了后来基于注意力的模型的归属技术. 一个互补的工作线应用注意流来量化信息如何通过变压器的堆叠层传播,为原始注意检查(Abnar and Zuidema, 2020年)提供了一个不太吵的替代方案,并且结合语言建模的封存被作为序列分类器的后热变体进行了研究(Harbecke, 2020年).

blocks.en: Gradient-based methods such as Input x Gradient ( Ali et al., 2022 ) and integrated gradients ( Sundararajan et al., 2017 ) attribute relevance through backpropagation. The axioms of implementation invariance and completeness that motivate integrated gradients make it an appealing reference method, although its sensitivity to the choice of baseline remains an open issue. Perturbation-based methods such as occlusion ( Robnik-Šikonja and Kononenko, 2008 ) measure the effect of removing or replacing input tokens; their simplicity is offset by a dependence on the perturbation policy (masking token, sliding window length, replacement distribution). Model-agnostic methods such as SHAP ( Lundberg and Lee, 2017 ) and LIME ( Ribeiro et al., 2016a ; Ribeiro et al., 2016b ) remain widely used because they can be applied to any classifier, although they are sensitive to perturbation design and reference values, and their KernelSHAP and LIME variants incur a non-negligible variance across runs unless the perturbation budget is increased. A recent ESWA study illustrates this combined use of self-supervised transformers with LIME and SHAP to provide interpretable predictions in a high-stakes classification setting, reporting state-of-the-art accuracy together with token-level explanations ( Bostancioglu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 渐变法如输入x渐变法(Ali等人,2022年)和集成梯度法(Sundararajan等人,2017年)通过反向传播赋予相关性. 造成综合梯度的不一致性和完整性,使它成为一种具有吸引力的参考方法,尽管它对基准选择的敏感性仍然是一个未决问题。 基于扰动的方法,如闭塞(Robnik-Šikonja和Kononenko,2008年)测量去除或替换输入符的效果;其简单性被依赖扰动政策(假象,滑动窗口长度,替换分布)所抵消. SHAP(Lundberg and Lee,2017年)和LIME(Ribeiro等人,2016年a;Ribeiro等人,2016年b)等模型不可知性方法仍然被广泛使用,因为它们可以适用于任何分类器,虽然它们对于扰动设计和参考值敏感,而它们的KernelSHAP和LIME变体则会产生不可忽略的差异,除非扰动预算增加. 最近的一项ESWA研究表明,这种自我监督变压器与LIME和SHAP相结合,在高分量的分类环境中提供可解释的预测,报告最新准确性,以及象征性解释(Bostancioglu等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: 2.3 Recent advances in attribution for transformers
blocks.zh: 第2.3条 最近变压器归属方面的进展

blocks.en: Recent methods aim to respect the internal structure of transformers. ALTI-Logit and AttnLRP decompose predictions into additive contributions across attention and feed-forward blocks ( Arras et al., 2025 ; Achtibat et al., 2024 ) . CA-LIG integrates layer-wise gradients with class-specific attention gradients to trace how representations evolve across layers ( Mersha and Kalita, 2026 ) . LLiMe uses a large language model to generate semantically coherent neighborhoods for LIME, mitigating the grammatical degradation caused by token removal ( Angiulli et al., 2025 ) . These advances are accompanied by a broader body of surveys that systematize explainability for large language models and deep models at scale ( Zhao and others, 2024 ; Di Marino and others, 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2025 ; Mehta et al., 2023 ; Longo et al., 2024b ; Milcke and others, 2024 ) , and by applied software libraries, discussed in the next subsection, that lower the barrier to deploying these methods in practice.
blocks.zh: 最近的方法旨在尊重变压器的内部结构. ALTI-Logit和AttnLRP将预测分解为跨关注区块和饲料前进区块的添加剂贡献(Arras等人,2025年;Achtibat等人,2024年). CA-LIG将分层梯度与特定类的注意梯度融合在一起,以追踪代表层之间的演变情况(Mersha和Kalita,2026年)。 LLiMe使用大型语言模型为LIME生成精密连贯的街区,缓解了信物清除导致的语法退化(Angiulli等人,2025年). 在取得这些进展的同时,还有一系列更广泛的调查,对大型语言模型和大规模深层模型进行系统化的解释(Zhao等人,2024年;Di Marino等人,2025年;Cheng等人,2025年;Mehta等人,2023年;Longo等人,2024年b年;Milcke等人,2024年b年),以及应用软件库,下一小节讨论了如何降低实际应用这些方法的障碍。

blocks.en: 2.4 XAI in medical text classification
blocks.zh: 2.4 医疗文本分类中的XAI

blocks.en: Explainability has been applied to text classification in medicine and in adjacent domains such as patent novelty analysis ( Jang et al., 2023 ) . In clinical text classification, explanations are expected not only to justify a label but also to indicate whether the model relies on legitimate clinical descriptors. Several ESWA contributions confirm that BERT-based architectures with attention mechanisms are now the default backbone for medical text tasks such as medical emergency prediction from unstructured clinical notes ( Mishra and Soni, 2025 ) and consumer health question classification ( Saedi et al., 2023 ) , although the post-hoc auditability of these models remains an open concern. Diagnostic studies of explanation techniques for text classification have shown that different methods can highlight different tokens even when the predicted label is the same ( Atanasova et al., 2020 ) ; this evidence is complemented by ground-truth benchmarks such as CLEVR-XAI ( Arras et al., 2022 ) , which make it possible to evaluate attributions against a controlled reference. Faithfulness and plausibility therefore need to be distinguished explicitly ( Jacovi and Goldberg, 2020 ; Lipton, 2018 ) . This paper follows that line and evaluates several methods against each other over a shared prediction rather than against a single ground-truth explanation, which is unavailable for transformer-based NLI over free-text medical abstracts.
blocks.zh: 在医学和专利新颖性分析等邻近领域,文字分类适用了解释性(Jang等人,2023年)。 在临床文本分类中,预计解释不仅可以证明标签的合理性,还可以说明模型是否依赖于合法的临床描述符. 一些ESWA的贡献证实,具有关注机制的基于BERT的架构现在是医疗文本任务的默认主干,如从无结构的临床笔记(Mishra and Soni, 2025)和消费者健康问题分类(Saedi等人, 2023)进行医疗紧急预测,尽管这些模型的事后可审计性仍然是一个公开的问题. 对文本分类解释技术的诊断研究表明,即使预测的标签相同,不同的方法也可以突出不同的标志(Atanasova等人,2020年);这种证据得到了CLEVR-XAI(Arras等人,2022年)等地面真实性基准的补充,这些基准使得对照受控的参考物评价归属成为可能. 因此,必须明确区分忠诚和可信度(Jacovi和Goldberg,2020年;Lipton,2018年)。 本文件沿用了这一条,并用共同的预测而不是单一的地面真实解释,相互评价了几种方法,而这种解释对于基于变压器的NLI, 而不是自由文本的医疗摘要来说是没有的。

blocks.en: 2.5 Comparative XAI frameworks and toolkits
blocks.zh: 2.5 比较XAI框架和工具包

blocks.en: Beyond single attribution methods, several toolkits and benchmarks have emerged to systematize the application and evaluation of XAI. Table 1 summarizes the most relevant ones for the present study. Quantus ( Hedström and others, 2023 ) and BEExAI ( Sithakoul et al., 2024 ) focus on the quantitative evaluation of explanations through fidelity, robustness and complexity metrics, and are agnostic to the attribution backend. Captum ( Kokhlikyan and others, 2020 ) provides a unified PyTorch API for gradient, perturbation and occlusion methods but offers only partial support for the disentangled attention of DeBERTa-v3. Inseq ( Sarti et al., 2023 ) targets sequence generation models and exposes feature attribution utilities, while Ecco ( Alammar, 2021 ) and BertViz ( Vig, 2019 ) emphasize visualization of attention and latent representations for encoder-only models. ALTI-Logit / AttnLRP ( Arras et al., 2025 ; Achtibat et al., 2024 ) implement layer-wise relevance propagation tailored to transformers, and LLiMe ( Angiulli et al., 2025 ) augments LIME with an LLM-based neighborhood generator. The table highlights that no single toolkit covers the five families of explanations compared in this paper natively for DeBERTa-v3, which motivates the native implementations detailed in Section 3 .
blocks.zh: 除了单一的归属方法外,还出现了几个工具包和基准,以系统化地应用和评价XAI。 表1概述了与本研究最相关的内容。 Quantus(Hedström等人,2023年)和BEExAI(Sithakoul等人,2024年)侧重于通过忠诚,坚固和复杂度的度量衡对解释进行定量评价,对归属后端具有不可知性. Captum(Kokhlikyan等,2020年)为梯度,扰动和隔离方法提供了统一的PyTorch API,但仅部分支持DeBERTa-v3的分散注意力. Inseq(Sarti等人,2023年)以序列生成模型为目标,并曝光特征归属公用事业,而Ecco(Alammar,2021年)和BertViz(Vig,2019年)则强调可视化关注,以及仅用于编码器模型的潜在表示. ALTI-Logit / AttnLRP(Arras等人,2025年;Achtibat等人,2024年)实施针对变压器的分层相关传播,LiMe(Angiulli等人,2025年)用基于LM的邻里发电机增强LIME。 该表强调,在本文中,没有任何单一的工具包涵盖与DeBERTa-v3相对照的五个家庭的解释,这激励了第3节详述的本地执行。

blocks.en: 2.6 Background: DeBERTa-v3 and zero-shot NLI
blocks.zh: 2.6 背景:DEBERTa-v3和零镜头NLI

blocks.en: DeBERTa-v3 ( He et al., 2021 ) improves on the original BERT architecture through three main innovations: disentangled attention, which represents each token as two vectors (content and position) and computes their interaction through a decomposable attention score; an enhanced mask decoder that predicts masked tokens only at the output of the decoder rather than at every layer, which mitigates the pre-training mismatch that arises when attention is computed on hidden states that already carry mask information; and a scale-invariant variant of the ELECTRA-style replaced-token-detection objective, which replaces the BERT-style magnitude invariance by a scale-invariant formulation that removes the dependence on the magnitude of the hidden representations. Together, these innovations produce a more expressive pre-training signal and a sharper attention computation, which is particularly beneficial for natural language inference tasks where the entailment decision depends on fine-grained token interactions over long premises.
blocks.zh: DeBERTa-v3(He等人,2021年)通过三大创新改进了原始的BERT架构: 分散注意力,代表每个符号为两个矢量(内容和位置),并通过可分解的注意力分数计算它们的相互作用; 增强的面具解码器,预言只在解码器输出时而不是每层都会有遮掩的信号,这缓解了在已经携带遮掩信息的隐藏状态上计算注意力时产生的训练前不匹配; 以及 ElecTRA 风格的取代托肯-检测目标的尺度-内变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变结果的BERTERT-ty的大小变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变变 这些创新加在一起,产生了一个更加表现性的训练前信号和更敏锐的注意计算,这对自然语言推论任务特别有利,因为所涉决定取决于长时间内精细的象征性互动。

blocks.en: Zero-shot NLI leverages these representations by recasting classification as an entailment problem: the model is trained on a generic NLI corpus and, at inference time, a class label is associated with a natural-language hypothesis; the input is classified by selecting the hypothesis whose entailment probability is highest. Laurer et al. (2023) released deberta-v3-large-zeroshot-v2.0 , the model used in this paper, which is obtained by fine-tuning DeBERTa-v3-large on a mixture of NLI and topic-classification datasets; the resulting model attains competitive accuracy on a wide range of topics without task-specific labels. The choice of zero-shot NLI for medical abstract classification is motivated by the scarcity of annotated clinical corpora and by the regulatory advantage of avoiding patient-level training data, but it transfers all the representational bias of the pre-training corpus to the downstream decision, which is one of the reasons that motivate the explainability audit reported here.
blocks.zh: 0shot NLI通过将分类重塑为引领性问题来利用这些表示性:该模型被训练为通用NLIbus,在推论时,一个类标签与自然语假说相关联;输入通过选择其引领概率最高的假说进行分类. Laurer等人(2023年)发布了Deberta-v3-great-zeroshot-v2.0,这是本文中使用的模型,通过在NLI和专题分类数据集的混合上微调DeBERTa-v3-group获得的;由此产生的模型在没有特定任务标签的情况下,在广泛的课题上获得了竞争性的精度. 选择医学抽象分类的零射NLI,是因为说明性临床蝎子的稀缺性,以及避免患者层面培训数据的监管优势,但它将训练前的表述偏差全部转移到下游决定,这也是激励本文所报道的解释性审计的原因之一.

blocks.en: 2.7 Research gap addressed
blocks.zh: 2.7 缩小研究差距

blocks.en: The literature review reveals three primary gaps in the explainability of clinical text classifiers. First, DeBERTa-v3 remains significantly less studied from an XAI perspective than BERT or RoBERTa, and standard toolboxes lack native support for its disentangled attention mechanism (Table 1 ), requiring custom model-level implementations for gradient and perturbation methods. Second, comparative XAI studies mostly depend on qualitative visual inspection or downstream acceptability, leaving the disagreement problem unmeasured through direct quantitative metrics across explainer families. Third, existing auditing protocols evaluate predictive accuracy in isolation, without examining how attribution fragmentation and explanation instability directly account for model failure in ambiguous clinical categories. To address these limitations, this paper introduces a unified auditing pipeline that tackles each gap directly. To overcome the architectural barrier, native attribution methods spanning three algorithmic families are implemented for DeBERTa-v3Ṫo resolve the evaluation deficit, pairwise inter-explainer agreement is quantitatively measured using the Jaccard index over standardized Top-20 tokens. Finally, to audit model vulnerability, a SHAP-based error analysis protocol is established to diagnose the root causes of predictive collapse and attribution anomalies in semantically overlapping classes.
blocks.zh: 文献审查揭示了临床文本分类器的可解释性存在三个主要差距. 首先,与BERT或RoBERTA相比,DeBERTa-v3从XAI角度的研究仍然少得多,标准工具箱缺乏对其分散的注意力机制的本土支持(表1),需要自定义的模型层面执行梯度和扰动方法. 第二,比较性高级研究所的研究主要取决于定性视觉检查或下游的可接受性,使分歧问题无法通过解释者家庭的直接定量衡量来衡量。 第三,现有的审计协议孤立地评价预测准确性,而不审查归属分裂和解释不稳定性如何直接说明模型在模糊的临床类别中的故障. 为解决这些局限性,本文件引入了直接解决每个差距的统一审计程序。 为了克服建筑障碍,DeBERTa-v3Ṫo公司实施了跨越三个算法家族的本土归属方法,解决评价不足的问题,利用Jaccard指数在标准化的Top-20标志上对解释者之间达成的协议进行定量衡量。 最后,为了审计模型脆弱性,建立了基于SHAP的错误分析协议,以诊断在模拟重叠类中预测崩溃和归属异常的根本原因.

blocks.en: 3.1 Corpus

blocks.en: The corpus is the Medical Abstracts dataset from Schopf et al. (2022) . The original collection contains 14,438 English medical abstracts with verified annotations. The taxonomy has five clinical categories. Four of them are specific diagnostic groups: neoplasms, digestive system diseases, nervous system diseases, and cardiovascular diseases. The fifth group, general pathological conditions, has a transversal nature and includes systemic or nonspecific states such as fever, fatigue, or diffuse inflammation. This last category introduces semantic overlap with the specific groups and motivates the explanation analysis.

blocks.en: 3.2 Inference Engine
blocks.zh: 3.2 推论引擎

blocks.en: The inference engine formulates classification as a natural language inference problem. Each medical abstract is the premise, and the category descriptions are the hypotheses. Given a premise x x and a candidate hypothesis h c h_{c} for category c ∈ { 1 , … , C } c\in\{1,\dots,C\} , the DeBERTa-v3 encoder produces three logits ( ℓ entail , ℓ neutral , ℓ contrad ) (\ell_{\text{entail}},\ell_{\text{neutral}},\ell_{\text{contrad}}) that score the compatibility between x x and h c h_{c} ( Laurer et al., 2023 ) . A softmax over the entailment logit and its alternatives converts this vector into an entailment probability p c = σ ⁡ ( ℓ entail , ℓ neutral , ℓ contrad ) p_{c}=\sigma(\ell_{\text{entail}};\,\ell_{\text{neutral}},\ell_{\text{contrad}}) quantifying the degree to which the premise entails that the abstract belongs to category c c .
The DeBERTa-v3 model ( Laurer et al., 2023 ; He et al., 2021 ) used is MoritzLaurer/deberta-v3-large-zeroshot-v2.0 .

For each premise, the five entailment probabilities of a category are averaged p ¯ c = 1 5 ​ ∑ r = 1 5 p c ( r ) , \bar{p}_{c}=\frac{1}{5}\sum_{r=1}^{5}p_{c}^{(r)}, (1) yielding an aggregated score per category. A softmax across categories then produces a normalized confidence distribution s c = e p ¯ c ∑ c ′ = 1 C e p ¯ c ′ , s_{c}=\frac{\mathrm{e}^{\bar{p}_{c}}}{\sum_{c^{\prime}=1}^{C}\mathrm{e}^{\bar{p}_{c^{\prime}}}}, (2) and the final label is assigned by the maximum confidence value c ^ = arg ⁡ max c ⁡ s c \hat{c}=\arg\max_{c}s_{c} . Operating under zero-shot learning means that no supervised training stage is performed on the target corpus: the model is used as released by its pretraining, and the only task-specific intervention is the design of the hypotheses, which acts as a form of multivariate prompt engineering. This choice eliminates the risk of data leakage between the training split and the evaluation, but transfers all the representational bias of the pretraining corpus to the downstream decision, an aspect revisited in Section 7 .
3.3 Explanation Methods
blocks.zh: 3.3 解释方法

blocks.en: Five explanation methods are selected. Two requirements guide the selection: class specificity, so that the explanation is computed for the predicted category rather than for a generic model output, and preservation of polarity, so that positive and negative contributions can be distinguished and the direction of the token’s influence on the predicted class can be inspected. The five methods belong to three families with different mathematical foundations: model-agnostic perturbation methods (SHAP, LIME), a local perturbation method (occlusion), a gradient method (Input x Gradient), and a transformer-specific method (Attention x Gradient). Computing a method from each family makes it possible to expose cross-family divergence, which is the empirical signature of the disagreement problem ( Krishna et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 选择了五个解释方法。 有两项要求指导选择:分类特殊性,以便计算出预测的类别而不是通用模型产出的解释,以及保留极性,以便区分正负两方面的贡献,并检查信使对预测的类别的影响方向。 这五种方法属于三个具有不同数学基础的家庭:模型不可知扰动方法(SHAP,LIME),局部扰动方法(吞噬),梯度方法(Input x Gradient),以及变压器特有的方法(Attention x Gradient). 从每个家庭计算出一种方法,就有可能暴露跨家庭的分歧,这是分歧问题的经验标志(Krishna等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: SHAP ( Lundberg and Lee, 2017 ) and LIME ( Ribeiro et al., 2016a ; Ribeiro et al., 2016b ) are applied through their Python libraries. Both methods are configured with 1,000 perturbations per sample to stabilize the attributions, which is well above the default budget of the libraries and is required to keep the estimator variance within a tolerable band over long medical abstracts. SHAP estimates the Shapley value of each token by averaging its marginal contribution across coalitions of features, producing an additive decomposition of the difference between the expected model output and the actual prediction; LIME fits a locally linear surrogate on a neighborhood of perturbed inputs and reads the coefficients of the surrogate as token attributions. Both methods return signed attributions that can be compared to the gradient- and occlusion-based outputs. The generative variant LLiMe ( Angiulli et al., 2025 ) is not included because of its computational cost for this volume of data, which would require the invocation of a large language model to generate semantically coherent perturbations for each of the 5,000 abstracts.

blocks.en: 3.4 Consistency Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.4 一致性分析

blocks.en: To address the disagreement problem across XAI frameworks with divergent mathematical foundations, a unified consistency analysis protocol is established, integrating attribution standardization and pairwise agreement quantification.
blocks.zh: 为了解决不同数学基础的XAI框架中的分歧问题,制定了统一的一致性分析协议,将归属标准化和双向协议量化结合起来。

blocks.en: Attribution Standardization (Top-20 Tokens): To compare methods with different mathematical bases, all attributions are standardized. For each explanation produced by one of the five methods, the k = 20 k=20 most relevant tokens are selected by absolute attribution value, and the polarity is retained only for visualization. The threshold k = 20 k=20 follows the range suggested by Chefer et al. (2021) and is intended to capture the main clinical entities of a medical abstract while limiting statistical noise from secondary tokens. Preliminary inspection showed that smaller thresholds ( k ∈ { 5 , 10 } k\in\{5,10\} ) over-emphasized a few dominant descriptors and increased the variance of the Jaccard index across pairs, whereas larger thresholds ( k ∈ { 50,100 } k\in\{50,100\} ) diluted the clinical core with particles and stopwords without substantially changing the comparative pattern; the choice of k = 20 k=20 therefore reflects a trade-off between signal and noise that is consistent with the median length of the diagnostic phrases in the corpus.
blocks.zh: 归属标准化( Top-20 Tokens): 为了将方法与不同的数学基础进行比较,所有归属都是标准化的. 对于五种方法之一产生的每一种解释,k = 20 k = 20 最具相关性的符号都是按照绝对归属值选择的,极性只保留用于可视化. 阈值 k = 20 k = 20 遵循Cefer等人(2021年)建议的范围,意在捕捉医学抽象的主要临床实体,同时限制统计噪声来自次品. 初步检查显示,较小的阈值(k ∈ { 5, 10 } k\ in 5, 10 })过分强调了少数主要描述词,增加了Jaccard指数跨对的差别,而较大的阈值(k ∈ { 50,100 } k\\ in 50,100 })用颗粒和止语稀释了临床核心,而没有大幅度改变比较模式;因此,选择k = 20 k = 20,反映了信号和噪声之间的权衡,这与本体诊断短语的中位长度一致.

blocks.en: Pairwise Agreement Quantification (Jaccard Index): Pairwise agreement between explanation methods is quantified with the Jaccard index over the Top-20 token sets ( Krishna et al., 2022 ) : J ⁡ ( A , B ) = | A ∩ B | | A ∪ B | , J(A,B)=\frac{|A\cap B|}{|A\cup B|}, (6) where A A and B B are the Top-20 token sets produced by two explanation methods for the same predicted case. A value close to one indicates that two methods agree on the relevant tokens, while a value close to zero indicates divergence. The index is computed for every pair of methods and for each clinical category.

blocks.en: The Jaccard index is adopted over alternative set-overlap measures for three reasons. First, it is threshold-free once the Top- k k sets are defined, which removes the need for an additional hyper-parameter. Second, it weighs intersection and union symmetrically, so that two methods each highlighting a different small set of tokens receive a low score even if the union is large; this property penalizes the kind of divergence that characterizes the disagreement problem. Third, the index is the only quantitative metric used in the comparative phase of this paper, as recommended by Krishna et al. (2022) for direct disagreement assessment; complementary ranking-aware measures such as the Rank-Biased Overlap ( Alvarez-Melis and Jaakkola, 2018 ) or fidelity metrics such as AOPC-sufficiency and comprehensiveness ( Hedström and others, 2023 ) are explicitly identified in Section 7 as future work, since their computation requires an additional experimental protocol that lies outside the scope of the present study.
blocks.zh: 基于三个原因,Jaccard指数被采用在替代的套期重叠措施之上。 首先,一旦Top-k k 集被定义,它就成为无阈值,这就不需要额外的超参数. 第二,它以对称的方式权衡交叉和结合,因此,即使结合规模很大,各有两种强调不同小套代币的方法获得较低的分数;这种财产惩罚分歧问题特有的分歧。 第三,按照Krishna等人(2022年)的建议,该指数是本文件比较阶段使用的唯一定量衡量标准,用于直接的分歧评估;诸如Rank-Biased Overlap(Alvarez-Melis和Jaakkola,2018年)或诸如AOPC-充足性和全面性(Hedström等人,2023年)等忠诚性衡量标准的补充排名认识措施在第7节中被明确确定为今后的工作,因为它们的计算需要额外的实验协议,不属于本研究的范围.

blocks.en: 3.5 Error Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.5 错误分析

blocks.en: A second protocol inspects the general pathological category, where the model shows the lowest accuracy. SHAP is used as a error analysis tool because it combines class specificity, polarity preservation, and a principled Shapley-value foundation that is robust to correlated features, which makes it suitable for interpreting individual predictions over long medical abstracts. For each misclassified case, the twenty most relevant tokens are visualized through saliency maps and waterfall plots. Saliency maps show positive contributions in magenta and negative contributions in blue. Waterfall plots quantify the marginal contribution of each token to the final prediction, decomposing the gap between the expected model output and the actual prediction into additive token contributions. The same 1,000-perturbation budget used in the comparative phase is retained here to ensure that the visualization is statistically stable.
blocks.zh: 第二种协议检查一般病理学类别,模型显示的准确度最低. SHAP被作为错误分析工具,因为它结合了类特异性,极性保存,以及一个原则性的沙普利价值基础,对相关特征很强,这使得它适合在长篇医学摘要中解释个人预测. 对于每一个被错误分类的案件,20个最相关的标志通过显像地图和瀑布地块可视化. 显著的地图显示对紫红色作出积极贡献,对蓝色作出消极贡献。 瀑布地块将每种物物对最终预测的边际贡献量化,将预期模型输出与实际预测之间的差距分解为添加物物贡献. 这里保留了比较阶段使用的同样的1000扰动预算,以确保可视化在统计学上稳定.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: This section describes the technical conditions under which the methodology of Section 3 is executed. We first report the software stack and the hardware used for the GPU-intensive stages (Section 4.1 ); we then describe the preprocessing applied to the Medical Abstracts corpus before sampling (Section 4.2 ); we state the reproducibility measures adopted to make the pipeline inspectable (Section 4.3 ); and we define the evaluation metrics used to report predictive performance and explanation agreement (Section 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 本节说明执行第3款方法的技术条件。 我们首先报告用于GPU密集阶段的软件堆和硬件(第4.1节);然后在取样前说明对医疗摘要的预处理(第4.2节);我们说明为使管道可以检查而采取的可复制措施(第4.3节);我们界定了用于报告预测性能和解释性协议的评价指标(第4.4节)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Implementation details
blocks.zh: 4.1 详细执行情况

blocks.en: The implementation is developed in Python 3.10.13 over Jupyter notebooks, which provides a cohesive workflow for executing the deep-learning inference, the statistical analysis of the clinical metrics, and the real-time documentation of the findings. The model is loaded through the Hugging Face Transformers library ( Wolf et al., 2020 ) . Data handling uses Pandas ( pandas development team, 2020 ) and NumPy ( Harris et al., 2020 ) . Evaluation metrics are computed with Scikit-learn ( Pedregosa et al., 2011 ) . Visualizations use Matplotlib ( Hunter, 2007 ) and Seaborn ( Waskom, 2021 ) . SHAP ( Lundberg and Lee, 2017 ) and LIME ( Ribeiro et al., 2016a ) are used for the agnostic explanations, while occlusion, Input x Gradient, and Attention x Gradient are implemented natively for DeBERTa-v3. The choice of native implementations is forced by the limited compatibility of standard XAI libraries with the disentangled attention mechanism of DeBERTa-v3, as discussed in Section 2.5 .
blocks.zh: Python 3.10.13在Jupyter笔记本上进行了实施,该笔记提供了执行深入学习推论、临床指标统计分析以及实时记录调查结果的一致工作流程。 该模型通过Hugging Face Transformers库(Wolf等人,2020年)加载. 数据处理使用熊猫(熊猫开发团队,2020年)和NumPy(Harris等人,2020年). 评价指标用Scikit-learn计算(Pedregosa等人,2011年)。 可视化使用Matplotlib(猎人,2007年)和Seaborn(Waskom,2021年). SHAP(Lundberg and Lee, 2017)和LIME(Ribeiro等人,2016年a)用于不可知性解释,而DeBERTa-v3的隔离,输入x渐变,以及注意x渐变,则在本地实施. 如第2.5节所述,由于标准XAI图书馆与DeBERTa-v3的分散关注机制的兼容性有限,本地执行的选择被迫进行。

blocks.en: The model has approximately 400 million parameters and is deployed on an Nvidia RTX 4050 GPU. The high computational demand of transformer inference at this scale, combined with the intensive gradient computation required by the attribution methods, is the main factor that bounds the evaluation to the 1,000-texts-per-category sample. A fixed random seed is used throughout the pipeline to reduce the variance of stochastic operations and to support reproducibility, mitigating the inherent stochasticity of the neural network and ensuring that the fidelity audits are consistent across successive runs of the pipeline.
blocks.zh: 该模型有大约4亿个参数,部署在Nvidia RTX 4050 GPU上. 本尺度下变压器推论的高计算需求,加上归属方法要求的密集梯度计算,是将评价限制在千字每类样本中的主要因素. 整个输油管都使用固定的随机种子,以减少线粒体操作的差异,支持再生产,减轻神经网络固有的线粒体特征,确保输油管连续运行的忠诚度审核一致.

blocks.en: 4.2 Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 4.2 预处理

blocks.en: The balanced sample is obtained through random sampling of 1,000 texts per category from the training split of the Medical Abstracts corpus, which contains 11,550 abstracts across the five categories. Sampling from the training split is admissible because the inference is zero-shot and therefore no supervised training is performed on the target corpus, which eliminates the risk of data leakage between the training and evaluation phases. Once sampled, the abstracts are loaded into a Pandas DataFrame and the original integer labels in the range 1–5 are converted to the zero-based range 0–4 required by the Hugging Face interface. No stemming, lemmatization, stopword removal, or other linguistic normalization is applied, because the transformer tokenizer operates directly on the raw text and preserves the lexical information that the explanation methods attribute. The hypotheses described in Table 3 are prepended to each abstract following the natural language inference template of the model, and the resulting premise–hypothesis pairs are tokenized with the DeBERTa-v3 tokenizer before being fed to the inference engine described in Section 3.2 .
blocks.zh: 均衡的样本是通过从《医疗摘要汇编》的培训分册中随机抽取每类1 000份文本获得的,该摘要汇编包含5类的11 550份摘要。 从培训分离中取样是可以接受的,因为推论是零镜头的,因此没有就目标体进行监督培训,这就消除了培训与评估阶段之间数据泄露的风险。 采样后,摘要被装入熊猫DataFrame,1–5范围内的原始整数标签被转换为Hugging Face接口所要求的0–4的零基范围. 由于变压器的标致器直接在原始文本上运行,并保存了解释方法赋予的词汇信息,因此没有应用阻断,句除,或其他语言正常化. 表3中描述的假设是按模型的自然语言推论模板准备给每个抽象的,由此产生的前提-假说对子在输入第3.2节所述的推论引擎之前,与DeBERTa-v3的示意剂配对。

blocks.en: 4.3 Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 4.3 可复制性

blocks.en: The inference engine, the explanation methods, and the validation protocol are implemented as separate stages so that the outputs of each stage can be inspected and reused independently. The intermediate artefacts of the pipeline (the per-abstract entailment probabilities, the per-token attributions of each method, and the per-pair Jaccard values) are persisted to disk so that the comparative analysis can be reproduced without re-running the GPU-intensive stages. The 1,000-perturbation budget used for SHAP and LIME is held fixed across all samples to ensure that the estimator variance is comparable across methods and categories, and the same budget is retained for the SHAP-based error analysis phase.
blocks.zh: 推论引擎,解释方法和验证协议作为单独的阶段执行,以便每个阶段的输出可以独立检查和再利用. 输油管的中间工艺品(每个抽取产生的概率、每种方法的每个托肯归属和每个pair Jacard值)一直粘贴在磁盘上,这样就可以复制比较分析,而无需重新运行GPU密集型阶段。 用于SHAP和LIME的1000扰动预算被固定在所有样本中,以确保估计值差异在方法和类别之间具有可比性,并且为基于SHAP的错误分析阶段保留同样的预算.

blocks.en: 4.4 Evaluation metrics
blocks.zh: 4.4 评价尺度

blocks.en: Predictive performance is reported through confusion matrices in both absolute counts and normalized form, per-class recall on the diagonal of the normalized matrix, and the aggregate F1 score computed by macro-averaging over the five categories. Explanation agreement is reported through pairwise Jaccard values per method pair and category, per-category averages obtained by averaging over the ten method pairs, and a global average across all method pairs and categories. The per-category standard deviations reported alongside the averages reflect the variability across method pairs, not across texts; this distinction is made explicit in Section 7 when discussing internal validity. The error analysis phase is reported qualitatively through saliency maps and waterfall plots, complemented by the structured failure patterns summarized in tables.
blocks.zh: 预测性业绩是通过下列两种方式报告的:绝对计数和正常形式的混淆矩阵、正常矩阵对角的每类召回,以及用对五类的宏观分析计算的总分F1。 解释性协议通过对等的Jaccard值(每套方法对等和每类),每类平均值(每套方法对等)和所有方法对等和每类的全球平均值报告。 与平均数一并报告的每类标准偏差反映了不同方法对的变异,而不是不同文本的变异;第7节在讨论内部有效性时对此作了明确区分。 错误分析阶段通过显著地图和瀑布地块进行质量报告,辅之以表格中概述的结构化故障模式。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 5 实验和结果

blocks.en: This section reports the empirical evidence at three levels of analysis: the predictive performance of the zero-shot engine on the balanced sample (Section 5.1 ), the explainability comparison across the five attribution methods (Section 5.2 ), and the cross-class aggregation of the agreement index that exposes the dependence of the disagreement problem on clinical specificity (Section 5.3 ). A fourth subsection reports the SHAP-based error analysis of the general pathological category, the category where the model exhibits the worst predictive performance and the weakest explanation agreement (Section 5.4 ).
blocks.zh: 本节在三个分析层次上报告经验性证据:0射引擎在均衡样品上的预测性能(第5.1节),五种归属方法之间的可解释性比较(第5.2节),协议指数的跨类汇总,揭示分歧问题对临床特异性的依赖性(第5.3节). 第四小节报告了基于SHAP的对一般病理类的错误分析,该类模型的预测性能最差,解释性最弱(第5.4节)。

blocks.en: 5.1 Predictive performance
blocks.zh: 5.1 预测业绩

blocks.en: The model is evaluated over 5,000 abstracts, with 1,000 texts per randomly sampled from each category of the training split. Figure 2 shows the confusion matrices in counts and normalized form. The diagonal is strong for the four specific categories. Neoplasms reach 85.70% recall, cardiovascular diseases 84.20%, digestive diseases 76.70%, and nervous system diseases 74.50%. The general pathological category collapses to 6% accuracy. In the count matrix, neoplasms concentrate a large share of the errors of the other categories, and 326 of the 1,000 general cases are misclassified as neoplasms. The aggregate F1 score is 0.60.
blocks.zh: 评价了5 000多份摘要,对每类培训进行随机抽取1 000份。 图2以计数和正常形式显示混淆矩阵。 对角线对应于四个具体类别。 肿瘤的复发率为85.70%,心血管疾病为84.20%,消化性疾病为76.70%,神经系统疾病为74.50%。 一般病理类崩溃到6%的精度. 在计数矩阵中,肿瘤集中了大量其他类别的错误,1000个普通病例中有326个被误归类为肿瘤. F1的总分为0.60分.

blocks.en: The per-category pattern is consistent with the semantics of the target labels. The four specific categories correspond to clinical ontologies with well-characterized vocabularies: oncological processes (neoplasms), hepatobiliary and gastrointestinal pathology (digestive), central and peripheral nervous system disorders (nervous), and cardiac and vascular pathology (cardiovascular). In these cases, the entailment engine discriminates the hypotheses confidently because the premise–hypothesis compatibility is anchored to a recognizable lexical field. The semantic overlap registered in the off-diagonal cells is also clinically interpretable: digestive-to-neoplasms errors often relate to hepatic oncology cases, and cardiovascular-to-general errors reflect shared hemodynamic descriptors. The pathological general category, by contrast, has a transversal definition that includes systemic states such as fever, fatigue, weakness and diffuse inflammation, which overlap lexically with every specific organ specialty; the collapse of its recall to 6%, with the missing mass distributed across the four specific categories, is a quantitative confirmation of this structural ambiguity and the main motivation for the dedicated error analysis protocol reported in Section 5.4 .
blocks.zh: 每类图案与目标标签的语义一致. 这四个具体类别对应具有良好特征词汇的临床本体学:肿瘤过程(肿瘤),肝肠病和胃肠病(Digestive),中外神经系统紊乱(神经),心血管病(心血管). 在这些情况下,引领引擎有自信地对假设加以歧视,因为前提-假设兼容性被固定在一个可识别的词典领域。 在非对角细胞中注册的语义重叠也是临床上可以解释的:消化对肿瘤误差往往与肝肿瘤病例有关,心血管对一般误差反映了共享的血动力描述符. 与此相反,病理学一般类别有一个横向定义,包括发烧、疲劳、疲软和散发性炎等系统状态,这与每个特定器官的特性在逻辑上是重叠的;其召回率的崩溃为6%,缺失的质量分布在四个特定类别之间,这是对这一结构模糊性的量化确认,也是第5.4节所报告的专门错误分析协议的主要动机。

blocks.en: 5.2 Explainability comparison
blocks.zh: 5.2 可解释性比较

blocks.en: Figure 3: Architecture for the comparison of explanation methods. Outputs of the five methods are standardized through Top-20 token extraction and compared with the Jaccard index.
blocks.zh: 图3:比较解释方法的结构。 这五种方法的产出通过Top-20代币提取实现标准化,并与Jaccard指数进行比较.

blocks.en: The primary objective of this experiment is to evaluate the local consistency of post-hoc explanation methods under high-certainty predictive scenarios, thereby directly quantifying the magnitude of the disagreement problem across divergent attribution families in clinical text classification. To achieve this, the evaluation operates through the comparative pipeline depicted in Figure 3 .
blocks.zh: 这一实验的主要目的是评价高确定性预测情景下的Hoc后解释方法的局部一致性,从而直接量化临床文本分类中不同归属家族的分歧问题的严重程度. 为此,评价通过图3所示的比较程序进行。

blocks.en: Table 4: Correctly classified cases used in the explainability comparison. Each abstract is summarized by its dominant clinical content; the full texts are available in the released experimental configuration.
blocks.zh: 表4:可解释性比较中使用的正确分类案件。 每个摘要都按其主要临床内容进行总结;全文在发布的实验配置中提供.

blocks.en: The architecture channels correctly classified medical abstracts through the five selected XAI methods (SHAP, LIME, Occlusion, Input × \times Gradient, and Attention × \times Gradient), standardizes their outputs by isolating the Top-20 most influential tokens, and computes pairwise Jaccard agreement metrics to evaluate inter-explainer stability. To establish a controlled and reproducible empirical baseline, Table 4 summarizes the five representative, correctly classified abstracts selected for this comparative audit—one per clinical category. Each case was chosen because it contains unambiguous, domain-specific clinical descriptors that a human expert would directly associate with the true diagnostic label. This single-case per category design ( N = 1 N=1 ) isolates inter-method variance from inter-text variability, providing an optimal benchmark to verify whether divergent attribution algorithms converge on a shared clinical core. Tables 5 – 9 detail the resulting pairwise Jaccard metrics and shared token sets for each diagnostic class. Across the four specific categories, the attribution methods demonstrate a clear qualitative convergence around key diagnostic entities:
blocks.zh: 架构通道通过所选的5个XAI方法(SHAP,LIME,Occulation,Inform ×\times Gradient,以及Recent × Times Gradient)正确分类医学摘要,通过隔离Top-20最有影响力的符号实现输出标准化,并计算成对的Jacard协议度量,以评估解释者间稳定性. 为了建立可控制和可复制的经验基线,表4总结了为这一比较审计选定的五名代表正确的分类摘要——每个临床类别一份。 选择每个病例是因为其中含有明确、具体领域的临床描述,即人类专家将直接与真正的诊断标签挂钩。 这种每类设计的单例(N=1N=1)将方法间差异与文本间差异隔离开来,为验证不同归属算法在共享临床核心上是否趋同提供了最佳基准. 表5 – 9 详细列出每个诊断类的双向Jaccard 测量和共享符号集。 在四个具体类别中,归属方法表明主要诊断实体在质量上有明显的趋同:

blocks.en: In sharp contrast, when inspecting the General pathological category (Table 9 ), no single token is shared across all five methods, and the mean agreement drops to its lowest value ( 0.171 ± 0.088 0.171\pm 0.088 , reaching a minimum pair agreement between LIME and Occlusion of only 0.036 0.036 ). These per-category results confirm that explanatory agreement is strongly conditioned by clinical specificity: unambiguous diagnostic labels foster a stable explanation core across method families, whereas broad, semantically overlapping classes lead to fragmented attributions.
blocks.zh: 与此形成鲜明对照的是,在检查一般病理学类别(表9)时,所有5种方法都没有共享单一的代号,平均协议下降到最低值(0.171 ± 0.088 0.171\pm 0.088),在LIME和Occulation之间达成最低对对协议的只有0.036 0.036. 这些逐类结果证实,解释性协议受临床特征的强烈制约:清晰的诊断标签有助于在方法家族中形成稳定的解释核心,而广义的、集体的重叠类则导致归属分散。

blocks.en: 5.3 Cross-class agreement analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 跨类别协议分析

blocks.en: Explanatory agreement is strongly conditioned by the underlying mathematical formulation of the attribution method rather than being a static property of the language model (Table 10 ). The highest convergence is consistently achieved between methods belonging to the same algorithmic family: model-agnostic perturbation techniques (SHAP–LIME, mean 0.31 ± 0.14 0.31\pm 0.14 ) and internal model-flow approaches (Input × \times Gradient–Attention × \times Gradient, mean 0.30 ± 0.12 0.30\pm 0.12 ). In contrast, cross-family comparisons involving attention-based mechanisms yield the lowest agreement in the study (e.g. SHAP–Attention × \times Gradient, mean 0.19 ± 0.08 0.19\pm 0.08 ). This divergence empirically confirms the disagreement problem in clinical NLP, demonstrating that a single explainer provides an incomplete view of the model’s decision boundary.
blocks.zh: 解释性协议主要取决于归属方法的基本数学表述,而不是语言模型的静态属性(表10)。 属于同一算法系的方法:模型不可知扰动技术(SHAP-LIME,指0.31±0.14 0.31\pm 0.14)和内部模型流方法(输入x\times Gradient-Attentionx\times Gradient,指0.30±0.12 0.30\pm 0.12)之间一致实现最高趋同. 与此相反,涉及关注机制的跨家庭比较在研究中取得了最低的一致(例如SHAP-Attention ×\times Gradient,指0.19±0.08 0.19\pm 0.08)。 这种分歧在经验上证实了临床NLP中的分歧问题,表明单一解释者对模型的决定界限提供了不完整的观点.

blocks.en: Furthermore, explanation stability exhibits a direct positive correlation with predictive confidence across clinical domains (Figure 2 and Table 10 ). Unambiguous diagnostic categories with well-defined clinical vocabularies—such as Neoplasms ( 85.70 % 85.70\% recall, mean Jaccard 0.33 ± 0.09 0.33\pm 0.09 ) and Cardiovascular diseases ( 84.20 % 84.20\% recall, mean Jaccard 0.28 ± 0.10 0.28\pm 0.10 )—foster a stable explanatory core centered on key pathological descriptors ( metastatic , liver , hypertension ). In contrast, diagnostic ambiguity in the General pathological category ( 6.00 % 6.00\% recall) induces a severe collapse in explanatory convergence (mean Jaccard 0.17 ± 0.09 0.17\pm 0.09 , reaching a minimum of 0.036 0.036 between LIME and Occlusion). When the model lacks a dominant clinical feature, attribution mass disperses onto secondary grammatical particles, rendering the post-hoc explanation unstable.
blocks.zh: 此外,解释稳定性显示出与临床领域预测信心的直接正相关关系(图2和表10)。 具有明确临床词汇的无矛盾的诊断类别——如Neoplasms(85.70%85.70%)召回,指Jaccard 0.33±0.09 0.33\pm 0.09)和心血管疾病(84.20%84.20%召回,指Jaccard 0.28±0.10 0.28\pm 0.10)——形成一个以关键病理学描述器(镇静剂、肝脏、高血压)为中心的稳定的解释性核心。 相比之下,一般病理类的诊断模糊性(6.00% 6.00\%召回)会导致解释性趋同严重崩溃(平均Jaccard 0.17 ± 0.09 0.17\pm 0.09,在LIME和Occulation之间至少达到0.036 0.036). 当模型缺乏主导临床特征时,归属质量会分散到二级语法粒子上,使得后热解释不稳定.

blocks.en: 5.4 Error analysis the general pathological category
blocks.zh: 5.4 一般病理类误差分析

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows the architecture used for the error analysis protocol. The pipeline is kept until the prediction stage, and SHAP is then used to inspect the decision of the model over the general pathological cases that are misclassified.
blocks.zh: 图4显示了用于错误分析协议的架构. 管道一直保存到预测阶段,然后SHAP被用来检查模型对被错误分类的一般病理病例的决定.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Architecture for the error analysis protocol of the general pathological category. SHAP attributions are visualized through saliency maps and waterfall plots.
blocks.zh: 图4 一般病理类错误分析协议的架构. SHAP的归属通过显著的地图和瀑布地块可视化.

Top driving tokens : tokens with the largest positive SHAP attribution per case. Failure pattern : LH lexical hypersensitivity, SO semantic overlap, LAC loss of attribution coherence (see text).
blocks.zh: 表11:与SHAP一起检查的5个分类错误的一般病理学案例摘要。 预测 : DeBERTa-v3指定的错误类别。 顶级驱动标志 : 每个案件最大正SHAP归属的标志. 失败模式 : LH语法超敏,SO语义重叠,LAC丧失归属一致性(见文本).

blocks.en: Five misclassified general cases are inspected. Each case is summarized in Table 11 together with the dominant tokens identified by SHAP, the predicted category, and the failure pattern assigned during the qualitative analysis. Table 12 complements this summary with a clinical description of the content of each misclassified abstract, which makes the failure patterns concrete: the texts refer to systemic processes (renal, infectious, procedural) that the model assigns to a specific specialty because of a dominant lexical cue. Two representative cases are described in detail below; the remaining three are discussed in compact form at the end of this subsection.
blocks.zh: 检查了5个分类错误的一般案件。 表11汇总了每个案例,以及SHAP确定的主要标志、预测类别和定性分析期间指定的失败模式。 表12以临床描述每个错分类抽象的内容来补充这个摘要,这使得故障模式变得具体: 文本是指模型由于一个占主导地位的词汇提示而指定给特定特长的系统过程(肾脏,传染性,程序性). 下文详述两个有代表性的案例;其余三个案例在本分节末尾以紧凑的形式讨论。

blocks.en: Table 12: Clinical content of the five misclassified general pathological cases. Predicted : erroneous category assigned by DeBERTa-v3. The true category in all cases is General pathological conditions .
blocks.zh: 表12:5个分类错误的一般病理病例的临床含量. 预测 : DeBERTa-v3指定的错误类别。 在所有情况下,真正的类别是一般病理条件。

blocks.en: The first case is classified as cardiovascular. The saliency map and the waterfall plot, shown in Figure 5 , indicate that tokens with vascular load such as hemodynamic , atherosclerosis , and glomerular push the prediction toward the cardiovascular category. The clinical acronym FSGHS, which refers to focal segmental glomerulosclerosis, has an attribution below the level needed to correct the prediction. The model thus prioritizes shared vascular descriptors over the systemic context of the abstract, illustrating the semantic overlap pattern: descriptors that are anatomically vascular inherit the diagnostic weight of a neighbouring specific category even when the abstract describes a systemic renal process.
blocks.zh: 第一个病例被归类为心血管. 图5显示的显著地图和瀑布图表明,血管负载如血动力学、心血管硬化症和光泽化等的符号将预测推向心血管类别。 临床缩略语FSGHS,指焦片光蛋白硬化症,其属性低于纠正预测所需的水平. 该模型因此将共享血管描述符放在抽象的系统上下文之上,说明了语义上的重叠模式:解剖血管的描述符会继承相邻特定类别的诊断权重,即使抽象语描述的是系统性肾脏过程.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Error analysis of a general case misclassified as cardiovascular. Left: saliency map. Right: SHAP waterfall plot.
blocks.zh: 图5:一般病例误认为心血管错误分析. 左:显要地图. 对: SHAP瀑布地块.

blocks.en: The second case is classified as neoplasms. Figure 6 shows that malignancy , tumor , and carcinoma are the main drivers of the prediction. The model identifies the correct label, but the explanation relies almost exclusively on explicit oncological terms and ignores the cellular transformation mediated by HPV-18, which is the central process of the abstract. This illustrates the lexical hypersensitivity pattern: the prediction is correct only because the abstract foregrounds explicit oncological terminology, but the underlying reasoning is fragile for texts that describe oncological processes without direct diagnostic vocabulary.
blocks.zh: 第二例被归类为肿瘤. 图6显示,恶性肿瘤、肿瘤和癌是预测的主要驱动因素。 模型识别出正确的标签,但解释几乎完全依赖于明显的肿瘤术语,忽略了HPV-18调解的细胞转化,这是抽象的核心过程. 这说明了词典的超灵敏度模式: 预测是正确的,只是因为抽象的前缘有明显的肿瘤学术语,但对于描述肿瘤过程而没有直接诊断词汇的文本来说,基础推理是脆弱的.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Error analysis of a general case misclassified as neoplasm. Left: saliency map. Right: SHAP waterfall plot.
blocks.zh: 图6:一般病例误归类为肿瘤的错误分析. 左:显要地图. 对: SHAP瀑布地块.

blocks.en: The remaining three cases corroborate the same patterns. The third case describes coagulation problems in patients with renal failure and is misclassified as cardiovascular because pressure and blood capture most of the predictive weight; negative mentions of renal mass are not processed as evidence against the circulatory class, replicating the semantic overlap pattern of case 1. The fourth case corresponds to an attribution collapse in which neither the saliency map nor the waterfall plot reveals a coherent clinical pattern, with the importance mass drifting towards grammatical particles such as the pronoun it or the verb diagnose ; this is the loss of attribution coherence pattern. The fifth case is misclassified as neoplasms because the token biopsy alone dominates the prediction, even though the abstract refers to an outpatient procedure with no oncological context; this confirms the lexical hypersensitivity pattern observed in case 2.
blocks.zh: 其余3起案件证实了同样的模式。 第三例描述肾衰竭患者的凝血问题,由于压力和血液捕捉到大部分的预测重量而被误归类为心血管;负面提及肾质不作为对抗循环类的证据处理,复制了第1例的语义重叠模式. 第四例对应的是归属崩溃,在这种崩溃中,显性图和瀑布地块都没有揭示一个连贯的临床模式,其重要性质量向语法粒子漂移,如代词或动词诊断;这就是归属一致性模式的丧失. 第五个病例被错误地归类为肿瘤,因为仅象征性的活检就主导了预测,尽管抽象指的是没有肿瘤背景的门诊手术;这证实了在案例2中观察到的语法超敏模式.

blocks.en: Across the five inspected cases, three recurring failure patterns are therefore identified. First, lexical hypersensitivity (cases 2 and 5): a single token such as biopsy or malignancy can dominate the prediction and shift the case toward neoplasms. Second, semantic overlap (cases 1 and 3): shared descriptors such as vascular or renal terms lead to a specific category when the abstract has a systemic nature, and negative evidence is not assimilated. Third, loss of attribution coherence (case 4): when no robust clinical descriptor is available, the attribution mass is distributed over grammatical particles or nonspecific terms, producing an erratic explanation rather than a structured clinical justification. This last pattern is consistent with the low Jaccard values observed for the general category in Table 10 , and it suggests that the health of the explanation itself can be used as a diagnostic signal for the reliability of the underlying prediction.
blocks.zh: 因此,在所检查的5个案件中,查明了3个一再发生的故障模式。 首先,词汇超灵敏度(例2和5):一个单一的征兆,如活检或恶性,可以支配预测,将病例转向肿瘤. 第二,语义重叠(例1和3):血管或肾脏术语等共用描述词在抽象具有系统性质时会导致特定类别,负面证据不被同化. 第三,归属一致性的丧失(例4):在没有强健的临床描述符时,归属质量分布在语法颗粒或非特定术语上,产生一种不稳定的解释,而不是结构化的临床理由. 最后一种模式与表10中普通类观察到的低雅克卡德值一致,它表明解释本身的健康性可以用作对基础预测可靠性的诊断信号.

blocks.en: Although this audit focuses on five structured cases, these instances are not isolated anomalies. Instead, they constitute a representative qualitative taxonomy that characterizes three systemic failure mechanisms inherent to zero-shot NLI in transformer architectures: 1. Lexical Hypersensitivity: Over-reliance on explicit high-salience terms (e.g., biopsy , malignancy ) that trigger premature category assignment regardless of procedural or diagnostic context. 2. Semantic Overlap: Inability to weigh negative clinical evidence when shared physiological descriptors (e.g., vascular or renal terms) overlap with specific organ specialties. 3. Loss of Attribution Coherence: Stochastic dispersion of feature importance onto secondary grammatical particles when the input text lacks a dominant clinical feature.
blocks.zh: 虽然这次审计侧重于五个结构化案例,但这些案例并非孤立的异常. 相反,它们构成了一种具有代表性的定性分类法,其特征是变压器结构中零射NLI所固有的三种系统故障机制: 1. 表征超灵敏度: 过度依赖明确的高地位术语(如活检、恶性),这些术语无论程序或诊断背景如何,都会触发过早的类别分配。 2. 语义重叠:当共享的生理描述(如血管或肾脏术语)与特定器官特征重叠时,无法权衡负面临床证据. 3. 丧失归属一致性:当输入文本缺乏主要临床特征时,特征重要性在二级语法颗粒上的分泌。

blocks.en: Lexical Hypersensitivity: Over-reliance on explicit high-salience terms (e.g., biopsy , malignancy ) that trigger premature category assignment regardless of procedural or diagnostic context.
blocks.zh: 显性超敏性:过度依赖明确的高显性术语(如活检,恶性),引发不成熟的类别分配,而不论程序或诊断背景如何.

blocks.en: Semantic Overlap: Inability to weigh negative clinical evidence when shared physiological descriptors (e.g., vascular or renal terms) overlap with specific organ specialties.
blocks.zh: 语义重叠:当共享的生理描述词(如血管或肾脏术语)与特定器官特征重叠时,无法权衡负面临床证据.

blocks.en: Loss of Attribution Coherence: Stochastic dispersion of feature importance onto secondary grammatical particles when the input text lacks a dominant clinical feature.
blocks.zh: 丧失归属一致性:当输入文本缺乏主要临床特征时,特征重要性在二级语法颗粒上的分泌。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: The results show two connected findings. The first is that explanation agreement is not a stable property of the model alone. It depends on the category and on the family of the explanation method. Agreement is higher within model-agnostic methods (SHAP–LIME, 0.31 on average) and within methods based on internal model flow (Input x Gradient–Attention x Gradient, 0.30), and lower between agnostic and attention-based methods (SHAP–Attention x Gradient, 0.19). This pattern confirms the disagreement problem in a clinical text setting and indicates that a single explainer can give a partial view of the decision process, in line with the practitioner-level concerns reported by Krishna et al. (2022) and the broader critique of Longo et al. (2024a) .
blocks.zh: 结果显示两个相关的调查结果。 第一种说法是,解释协议不仅仅是模型的稳定财产。 它取决于解释方法的类别和家族. 在模型不可知性方法(SHAP-LIME,平均0.31)和基于内部模型流的方法(投入x渐变x留级x渐变,0.30)中,协议率较高,在不可知性方法和基于注意力的方法(SHAP-专级x渐变,0.19)中,协议率较低. 这种模式证实了临床文本设置中的分歧问题,并表明,根据Krishna等人(2022年)和Longo等人(2024年a年)更广泛的批评,单一的解释者可以对决定过程提供部分看法。

blocks.en: The second finding is the relation between predictive performance and explanation stability. The four specific categories combine higher accuracy with a shared clinical core in the explanations, with the per-category Jaccard average spanning 0.24 (nervous system) to 0.33 (neoplasms). The general category combines the lowest accuracy (6%), the absence of a shared clinical core, and the lowest Jaccard value (0.17). When the model has a robust clinical descriptor, the explanation methods tend to converge on that descriptor; for neoplasms, the token metastatic is selected by all five methods, and for digestive diseases, liver plays the same role. When the input is semantically ambiguous, the attributions become fragmented and the disagreement increases. This observation supports the combined use of several explanation methods and a quantitative agreement metric instead of a single visual explanation, complementing the diagnostic study of Atanasova et al. (2020) , who reported method-dependent highlighting for text classifiers but did not quantify the divergence per category.
blocks.zh: 第二个结论是预测性能与解释稳定性之间的关系。 四个具体类别在解释中结合了更高的准确度和共同临床核心,每个类别Jaccard平均值为0.24(神经系统)至0.33(肿瘤)。 一般类结合了最低精度(6%),缺乏共享临床核心,以及最低的Jaccard值(0.17). 当模型有强健的临床描述符时,解释法往往与该描述符一致;对于肿瘤来说,符号元静态由所有五种方法选择,对于消化性疾病,肝起同样的作用. 当投入的语义模糊不清时,归属就变得支离破碎,分歧就会增加. 这一意见支持合并使用几种解释方法和量化协议的衡量标准,而不是单一的直观解释,补充了Atanasova等人(2020年)的诊断研究,后者报告说文本分类器采用方法依赖突出,但没有量化每个类别的差异。

blocks.en: The error analysis provides additional evidence. The five misclassified general cases summarized in Table 11 do not fail because of random noise only. They fail because the model assigns a large weight to specific lexical cues that belong to adjacent categories: a single token such as biopsy (case 5) flips the prediction towards neoplasms even when the abstract has no oncological context, and shared vascular descriptors pull systemic cases towards cardiovascular (cases 1 and 3). Most tellingly, case 4 exhibits an attribution collapse in which the importance mass drifts onto grammatical particles such as the pronoun it or the verb diagnose , mirroring the loss of attribution coherence reported in the qualitative literature on explanation failure ( Jacovi and Goldberg, 2020 ) . This behavior is problematic in a zero-shot setting, where no task-specific training corrects the prior induced by the pretraining corpus, and where the absence of supervision means that the only regulator of the decision boundary is the natural language inference scoring mechanism described in Section 3.2 .
blocks.zh: 错误分析提供了更多的证据。 表11概述的五个错误分类的一般案件并非仅因随机噪音而失败。 它们失败的原因是模型给属于相邻类别的特定词典提示分配了很大份量:一个单一的符号,如活检(例5),将预测推向肿瘤,即使抽象没有肿瘤上下文,共享血管描述符将系统病例拉向心血管(例1和3). 最能说明问题的是,案例4显示归属崩溃,其重要性漂移到语法粒子上,如代词或动词诊断,这反映了解释失败定性文献中所报告的归属一致性的丧失(Jacovi and Goldberg, 2020)。 这种行为在零镜头设定中存在问题,在零镜头设定中,没有针对特定任务的训练纠正了预先训练令之前诱导的,没有监督意味着决定界限的唯一调节者是第3.2节描述的自然语言推论评分机制.

blocks.en: A practical implication follows from this analysis: broad diagnostic labels such as general pathological conditions are harder to audit than specific ontologies because their language structurally overlaps with several specific categories. The transformer, lacking task-specific supervision, inherits the lexical statistics of its pretraining corpus and amplifies whatever diagnostic cue is most strongly associated with a specific class. From an accountability standpoint this makes the general category an unsafe target for an automated decision system, because the post-hoc explanation cannot disambiguate a legitimate systemic diagnosis from a positive mention of an adjacent specialty. This motivates the design recommendation, also echoed by European Data Protection Supervisor (2023) and the regulatory debate around the European AI Act ( European Commission, 2021 ; Di Marino and others, 2025 ) , that clinical classification targets should favour specific ontologies whenever auditability is a requirement, and that the residual systemic class should be either refined through a secondary multi-label structure or routed to manual review.
blocks.zh: 这一分析产生了实际影响:一般病理条件等宽泛的诊断标签比具体本体更难审计,因为其语言结构上与几个具体类别重叠. 变压器缺乏特定任务监督,继承了它预训本的词汇统计,并放大了任何诊断提示与特定类别最紧密的联系. 从问责制的角度来看,这使一般类别成为自动决策系统的不安全目标,因为事后的解释不能将合理的系统诊断与正面提及相邻的特异性相混淆。 这激励了设计建议,欧洲数据保护监督员(2023年)和围绕欧洲AI法案的监管辩论(欧盟委员会,2021年;Di Marino等人,2025年)也对此有所响应,临床分类目标在可审计性成为一项要求时,应当偏向于具体的本体学,剩余系统类要么通过二级多标签结构加以完善,要么进行人工审查.

blocks.en: The findings are aligned with previous reports on the disagreement problem ( Longo et al., 2024a ; Krishna et al., 2022 ) and with the recommendation to evaluate explanations quantitatively through standardized benchmarks ( Sithakoul et al., 2024 ; Hedström and others, 2023 ; Atanasova et al., 2020 ) . They also complement related XAI work for text classification in adjacent domains ( Jang et al., 2023 ) by showing, specifically for a transformer-based medical zero-shot setting, how explanation agreement can be used as a diagnostic signal of model uncertainty rather than only as a property to be reported. Two aspects of this signal deserve emphasis. First, the Jaccard index used here measures set overlap without considering ranking; a complementary study using rank-aware measures such as the Rank-Biased Overlap ( Alvarez-Melis and Jaakkola, 2018 ) or fidelity metrics such as AOPC-sufficiency and comprehensiveness ( Hedström and others, 2023 ) would help disentangle cases in which the same tokens are selected but ranked very differently. Second, the present protocol samples one case per category for the comparative analysis; while this is sufficient to expose the divergence pattern across method families, an inter-text variability study with a larger N N is needed before extrapolating the per-category averages to a population of inputs. Both extensions are discussed in Section 7 .
blocks.zh: 调查结果与以往关于分歧问题的报告(Longo等人,2024a;Krishna等人,2022年)和关于通过标准化基准对解释进行定量评价的建议(Sithakoul等人,2024年;Hedström等人,2023年;Atanasova等人,2020年)相一致。 它们还补充了XAI在相邻域中文本分类的相关工作(Jang等人,2023年),具体显示基于变压器的医学零发设定,解释协议如何可以用作模型不确定性的诊断信号,而不仅仅是要报告的财产. 这一信号有两个方面值得强调。 首先,此处使用的Jaccard指数在不考虑排名的情况下设定了重叠;利用诸如Rank-Biased Overlap(Alvarez-Melis和Jaakkola, 2018年)或诸如AOPC-充足性和全面性(Hedström等人, 2023年)等忠诚度度量度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度 第二,本协议对每个类别一个案例进行抽样比较分析;虽然这足以揭示不同方法家族之间的差异模式,但在将每个类别平均值推算为投入总量之前,需要进行一个N值较大的文本间变异性研究。 第7节讨论了两个延期。

blocks.en: 7 Scope of Validity and Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 有效性和限制的范围

blocks.en: The findings and empirical conclusions of this study are bounded by specific experimental conditions and methodological design choices, which define its scope of validity:
blocks.zh: 这项研究的结论和经验结论以具体的实验条件和方法设计选择为条件,界定其有效性范围:

blocks.en: Construct Validity and Metric Scope: The pairwise Jaccard index over Top-20 token sets captures set overlap while discarding token ranking and absolute attribution magnitude. Selecting k = 20 k=20 tokens strikes an optimal trade-off between capturing dominant clinical entities and filtering out statistical noise; however, k k remains a design parameter. Complementary ranking-aware measures (e.g., Rank-Biased Overlap) and causal fidelity tests (e.g., AOPC-sufficiency and comprehensiveness) represent natural extensions to evaluate fine-grained token hierarchies.
blocks.zh: 构造有效性和计量范围: 双智的Jaccard指数凌驾于Top-20令牌之上,设定了捕获器的重叠,同时放弃了令牌的排名和绝对归属级. 选择k = 20 k = 20 令牌在捕捉占支配地位的临床实体和过滤统计噪声之间产生最佳的权衡;然而,k k 仍然是设计参数. 补充性分级认识措施(如Rank-Biased Overlap)和因果忠诚度测试(如AOPC-充足性和全面性)是评价细微的象征等级的自然延伸.

blocks.en: Internal Validity and Sample Protocol: The comparative XAI phase employs a controlled single-case per category design ( N = 1 N=1 ) to isolate inter-method variance from inter-text variability, establishing a reproducible baseline across explainer families. Consequently, the reported standard deviations reflect variability across method pairs rather than across inputs. Similarly, the error audit examines five structured cases to construct a qualitative failure taxonomy. While these samples successfully expose systemic divergence patterns, broader population-level sampling will further quantify the exact prevalence of each failure mode across large patient cohorts.
blocks.zh: 内部有效性和样本议定书: 比较的XAI阶段采用每类设计(N=1N=1)一个可控的单例,将方法间差异与文本间变异区分开来,在解释者家庭之间建立可复制的基线. 因此,所报告的标准偏差反映的是方法对的变异,而不是投入的变异。 同样,错误审计审查了五个结构化案例,以构建质量故障分类。 虽然这些样本成功地暴露了系统性差异模式,但更广泛的人口一级抽样将进一步量化大患者群体中每种故障模式的确切流行率。

blocks.en: External Validity and Model Domain: The evaluation focuses on zero-shot inference using DeBERTa-v3-large on the Medical Abstracts corpus. This setup audits the native representational space of the transformer without task-specific fine-tuning. Replicating this protocol across alternative backbones (e.g., BioBERT, ClinicalBERT) or supervised fine-tuning regimes will delineate how domain-specific adaptation stabilizes explanation agreement. Advanced frameworks such as LLiMe and AttnLRP were excluded due to computational constraints and compatibility limits with DeBERTa-v3, representing key targets for future integration.
blocks.zh: 外部有效性和模型域 : 评价的重点是使用DeBERTa-v3大片的医学摘要法进行零镜头推论。 本设置对变压器的原生代表空间进行审核,不进行具体任务的微调. 通过替代主干线(如BioBERT, ClinicalBERT)复制这一协议或监督的微调制度,将划定特定领域适应如何稳定解释协议. 由于计算限制和与DeBERTa-v3的兼容性限制,LLiMe和AttnLRP等高级框架被排除在外,这是未来整合的关键目标。

blocks.en: Reliability and Stochastic Stability: Stochastic components (sampling, perturbation-based explainers) are governed by a fixed random seed, and SHAP/LIME attributions are stabilized using a 1,000 perturbation budget per sample. While this budget keeps estimator variance within a narrow band, evaluating empirical variance across multiple random seeds remains a valuable step for future benchmark extensions.
blocks.zh: 可靠性和Stochastic Stability:Stochastic组件(抽样,扰动基解释器)由固定的随机种子管理,SHAP/LIME的归属使用每个样本1000扰动预算得到稳定. 虽然这一预算在狭义范围内保持了估计差异,但评价多种随机种子的经验差异仍然是今后延长基准的宝贵步骤。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusions and Future Work
blocks.zh: 8 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: This paper presents a comparative explainability framework for DeBERTa-v3 in zero-shot medical abstract classification. Five explanation methods spanning three algorithmic families were evaluated through Top-20 token attribution and the pairwise Jaccard index over the Medical Abstracts corpus under a natural language inference engine with five enriched hypotheses per category.
blocks.zh: 本文在零镜头医学抽象分类中为DeBERTa-v3提供了比较解释框架. 在自然语言推论引擎下,通过TOP-20符号归属和医学摘要目录上的双智Jacard指数,对跨越三个算法家族的5种解释方法进行了评价,每个类别有5种丰富的假设。

blocks.en: The empirical findings demonstrate that explanatory agreement directly tracks predictive performance across clinical domains: specific categories with well defined ontologies foster high accuracy and a stable, shared clinical core across explainers, whereas broad, semantically overlapping classes induce predictive collapse and severe attribution fragmentation. Furthermore, the error analysis protocol identified lexical hypersensitivity, semantic overlap, and loss of attribution coherence as three systemic failure mechanisms in zero-shot NLI architectures.
blocks.zh: 经验结论表明,解释性协议直接跟踪临床领域的预测性能:具有明确定义的本体特征的特定类别可培养高精度,并在解释者之间形成稳定、共享的临床核心,而广泛、精密的重叠类则会导致预测性崩溃和严重的归属分裂。 此外,误差分析协议将词典超灵敏度,语义重叠和归属一致性的丧失确定为零射NLI架构中的三个系统故障机制.

blocks.en: Three practical indications follow from this audit. First, single-explainer audits are insufficient for transformer-based medical classifiers because attribution paths depend heavily on the underlying explainer family. Second, pairwise agreement metrics over standardized T ​ o ​ p ​ - ​ k Top\text{-}k tokens provide a compact, actionable diagnostic signal of explanation reliability. Third, target taxonomies in clinical NLP should prioritize specific ontologies over broad diagnostic labels whenever auditability is a requirement.
blocks.zh: 审计中有三个实际迹象。 首先,单一解释者审计对于基于变压器的医疗分类器来说是不够的,因为归属路径在很大程度上依赖于基本的解释者家族. 其次,在标准化的T o p - k Top\text{ -}k 符号之上的双向协议度量法提供了一个紧凑、可操作的解释可靠性诊断信号。 第三,临床NLP中的目标分类应优先考虑具体的本体学,在需要审计时,应优先考虑广义的诊断标签。

blocks.en: Building on these findings, future research will advance along four strategic avenues. First, the evaluation benchmark will be expanded to incorporate cutting-edge attribution methods—such as generative neighborhood explainers ( LLiMe ), layer-wise relevance propagation ( AttnLRP ), and context-aware layer-wise integrated gradients ( CA-LIG )—to further mitigate grammatical perturbation noise and capture deep representation flows. Second, to better accommodate explanatory uncertainty, the validation protocol will transition from crisp set-overlap metrics toward Fuzzy Jaccard similarity measures and fuzzy set theory, enabling a more continuous and nuanced modeling of token relevance. Third, formal domain ontologies will be integrated into the standardization protocol to map raw tokens onto standardized clinical concepts, evaluating explanatory convergence at a conceptual level rather than strictly at the surface lexical level. Finally, the comparative auditing framework will be generalized and standardized beyond clinical text classification to encompass alternative domains and data modalities, including Computer Vision and tabular data, establishing a unified, domain-agnostic protocol for multi-explainer reliability.
blocks.zh: 在这些结论的基础上,今后的研究将沿着四个战略途径取得进展。 首先,将扩大评价基准,以纳入尖端的归属方法,例如基因邻里解释器(LLiMe)、分层关联传播(AtnLRP)和上下文感地层综合梯度(CA-LIG),以进一步减少语法扰动噪音并捕捉深层代表流。 其次,为了更好地适应解释性的不确定性,验证协议将从简洁的套装重叠度量表过渡到模糊的Jaccard相似度量和模糊的成套理论,从而能够更连续和细微地模拟象征性的相关性。 第三,将正式域本体学纳入标准化协议,将原始符号映射到标准化的临床概念上,在概念层面而不是严格在表面词汇层面评价解释性趋同。 最后,比较审计框架将在临床文本分类之外得到普遍和标准化,以涵盖替代领域和数据模式,包括计算机远景和表格数据,为多解释者可靠性建立一个统一的域不可知协议。
